newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK BUSINESSMEN PREPARE FOR EUROPARTENARIAT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK BUSINESSMEN PREPARE FOR EUROPARTENARIAT.

text.p: More than 3,000 businessmen from 77 countries will meet in Piraeus on June 23 and 24 to discuss international cooperation during a Europartenariat conference, the organisers said in a statement.
Representatives from Europe, the Middle East, the United States and Asia will gather in Athens on Thursday and Friday to prepare the meeting, the statement said.
Organisers said that for the first time 400 Greek businesses will be systematically promoted worldwide by local promotion companies ahead of the conference.

Europartenariat organisers, Greece's national economy ministry and European Union officials will present the targets set for the Greek economy at the meeting during a news conference on Thursday at 0900 GMT at the Athens Hilton hotel. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
